Albumentations offers a wide range of transformations for both 2D (images, masks, bboxes, keypoints) and 3D (volumes, volumetric masks) data, with optimized performance and seamless integration into ML workflows.

info.author: Vladimir I. Iglovikov, Mikhail Druzhinin, Alex Parinov, Alexander Buslaev, Eugene Khvedchenya
classifiers: Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules
info.keywords: image augmentation, data augmentation, computer vision, deep learning, machine learning, image processing, artificial intelligence, augmentation library, image transformation, vision augmentation
info.name: albumentations
info.summary: An efficient library for image augmentation, providing extensive transformations to support machine learning and computer vision tasks.
